title: 第11章 君临不死山人皇你越界了第12章 学历造假叶天帝连吃带拿林人皇
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
去各大生命禁区逛一圈！？
姜恒宇豁然起身。
他不顾身边娇媚仙子的错愕，呆呆的看着眼前的聊天群页面，眼底闪烁着浓浓的激动，被这一句话中的大气魄给生生的震撼到了。
这就是古皇！
这就是大帝！
在真正的古之大帝眼中。
所谓的生命禁区不过是想逛就逛的后花园罢了。
历代大帝证道过后。
基本上都会去各大生命禁区逛上一圈。
这已经是一个传统了。
听说……
生命禁区里面的好东西很多啊。
【人欲道祖师爷：人皇前辈要去巡视北斗的各大生命禁区？那我与叶凡道友今日倒是可以开开眼了！】
【叶黑：生命禁区？这是什么地方？】
【人欲道祖师爷：北斗葬帝星有六大生命禁区，它们分别是不死山、神墟、太初古矿、仙陵、轮回海、葬天岛，每一座生命禁区都是真正的禁地，传闻其中沉眠着昔年的古代至尊……】
【我所在的时代名为荒古时代，位于人皇所在的太古时代之后，在我的这个时代，经常有黑暗至尊引发动乱。】
【唉。】
【世间苦至尊久矣。】
【未来我若是能够证道成帝，必然要震慑各大生命禁区！平定动乱！】
【叶黑：黑暗至尊引发动乱？】

【人欲道祖师爷：古代至尊从无尽岁月之前一直沉眠至此，只为等待成仙路的开启，期间若是寿元不足，他们会选择出世吞噬万灵，以万灵的精气弥补自身的亏损。】
【叶黑：什么？这不就是吃人吗？】
【人欲道祖师爷：吃人？对！就是吃人！】
叶凡有些沉默。
他震撼的看着眼前的群聊页面。
这还是他第一次接触到修行界的残酷一面。
……为了成仙而选择吃人？
他自认做不到！
“都说修行界哪里都是仙气飘飘的样子？这特么压根就是个吃人不吐骨头的世界！”
“很残酷！”
“很绝望！”
“但也…非常的刺激！”
叶凡的眼眸微微闪烁片刻。
他轻轻抚摸着自己那不断跳跃的心脏，感觉到体内有着一股热血在流淌……
【人皇林昭：后世有黑暗至尊引发动乱？哪个禁区的？你说，我现在就去走一趟！】
【叶黑：卧槽！人皇开始点名！】
【人欲道祖师爷：不死山！我曾听闻几万年前就有不死山的古代至尊出世引发了黑暗动乱！】
【人皇林昭：好。】
【叮！】
【管理员·人皇林昭（极道至尊）开启了群聊直播——邀您观看！】
content_en:
Go shopping in all the restricted areas of life! ?
Jiang Hengyu suddenly stood up.
Ignoring the astonishment of the charming fairy beside him, he stared blankly at the chat group page in front of him, his eyes flashing with excitement, and he was shocked by the grandeur of this sentence.
This is the ancient emperor!
This is the emperor!
In the eyes of the real ancient emperor.
The so-called restricted area of ​​life is nothing more than a back garden where you can wander around whenever you want.
After the great emperors of all dynasties attained enlightenment.
Basically, I go to all the restricted areas of life.
This has become a tradition.
I heard...
There are many good things in the restricted area of life.
[Master of Human Desire Dao: Senior Human Emperor is going to inspect the major restricted areas of life in Beidou? Then Taoist friend Ye Fan and I can open our eyes today! 】
[Ye Hei: The restricted area of life? What is this place? 】
[Master of Human Desire Dao: Beidou Emperor Burial Star has six forbidden areas of life. They are the Immortal Mountain, the Ruins of Gods, the Ancient Mines of Taichu, the Immortal Tomb, the Sea of Reincarnation, and the Buried Heaven Island. Each forbidden area of life is a real forbidden area. It is rumored that the ancient supreme beings of the past are sleeping in them...]
[The era I am in is called the Ancient Era, which is located after the Ancient Era where the Human Emperor is. In my era, the Dark Supreme often causes turmoil. 】
【well. 】
【The world has been suffering for a long time. 】
[If I can achieve enlightenment and become an emperor in the future, I will definitely shock all the restricted areas of life! Put down the unrest! 】
[Ye Hei: The Dark Supreme caused unrest? 】
[Master of the Way of Human Desire: The ancient supreme beings have been sleeping here since endless years, just waiting for the opening of the road to immortality. During this period, if their life span is insufficient, they will choose to be born to devour all spirits, and use the essence of all spirits to make up for their own losses. 】
[Ye Hei: What? Isn't this just cannibalism? 】
[Master of the Way of Human Desire: Cannibalism? right! Just cannibalism! 】
Ye Fan was a little silent.
He looked at the group chat page in front of him in shock.
This was the first time he came into contact with the cruel side of the spiritual world.
...Choose to eat people in order to become an immortal?
He thought he couldn't do it!
"They say that everywhere in the world of cultivation is filled with immortal energy? This is a world that eats people without spitting out their bones!"
"It's cruel!"
"Desperate!"
"But it's also... very exciting!"
Mark's eyes flickered slightly for a moment.
He gently stroked his beating heart and felt a warm blood flowing in his body...
[Human Emperor Lin Zhao: Will a Dark Lord cause turmoil in future generations? Which restricted area? You said, I'm going to take a trip now! 】
[Ye Hei: Damn it! The Emperor of Humanity began to call names! 】
[The Patriarch of the Way of Human Desire: The Mountain of Immortality! I once heard that the appearance of the ancient supreme being from the Immortal Mountain tens of thousands of years ago caused dark turmoil! 】
[Human Emperor Lin Zhao: OK. 】
[Ding! 】
[Administrator·Human Emperor Lin Zhao (Jidao Supreme) has started a live group chat - you are invited to watch! 】
